```{r simple}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(plotly)

# Add country names back to migration data
names(migration)[names(migration) == ""] <- "unnamed_col"
names(migration) <- make.names(names(migration), unique = TRUE)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Global Migration Patterns"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      # Origin filters
      h4("Origin (From)"),
      selectInput(
        inputId = "filterTypeFrom",
        label = "Filter by:",
        choices = c("Country", "Region", "Continent")
      ),
      uiOutput("dynamicFromInput"),
      
      # Destination filters
      h4("Destination (To)"),
      selectInput(
        inputId = "filterTypeTo",
        label = "Filter by:",
        choices = c("Country", "Region", "Continent")
      ),
      uiOutput("dynamicToInput"),
      
      # Month/Year slider
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "monthInput",
        label = "Month Range",
        min = 1,
        max = 12,
        value = c(1, 12),
        step = 1
      ),
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "yearInput",
        label = "Year Range",
        min = 2019,
        max = 2022,
        value = c(2019, 2020),
        step = 1,
        sep = "",
        ticks = TRUE
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("migrationPlot", height = "500px"),
      br(), br(),
      DTOutput("results")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Dynamic FROM dropdown based on filter type
  output$dynamicFromInput <- renderUI({
    choices <- switch(input$filterTypeFrom,
      "Country" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$country_from_name))),
      "Region" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$region_from))),
      "Continent" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$continent_from)))
    )
    
    selectInput(
      inputId = "fromInput",
      label = paste("Select", input$filterTypeFrom),
      choices = choices,
      selected = choices[1]
    )
  })
  
  # Dynamic TO dropdown based on filter type
  output$dynamicToInput <- renderUI({
    choices <- switch(input$filterTypeTo,
      "Country" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$country_to_name))),
      "Region" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$region_to))),
      "Continent" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$continent_to)))
    )
    
    selectInput(
      inputId = "toInput",
      label = paste("Select", input$filterTypeTo),
      choices = choices,
      selected = choices[1]
    )
  })
  
  # Filter data based on inputs
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$fromInput, input$toInput)
    
    # Determine which columns to filter on
    from_col <- switch(input$filterTypeFrom,
      "Country" = "country_from_name",
      "Region" = "region_from",
      "Continent" = "continent_from"
    )
    
    to_col <- switch(input$filterTypeTo,
      "Country" = "country_to_name",
      "Region" = "region_to",
      "Continent" = "continent_to"
    )
    
    migration %>%
      filter(
        .data[[from_col]] == input$fromInput,
        .data[[to_col]] == input$toInput,
        migration_month >= input$monthInput[1],
        migration_month <= input$monthInput[2],
        migration_year >= input$yearInput[1],
        migration_year <= input$yearInput[2]
      )
  })
  
  # Aggregated data for plotting
  plot_data <- reactive({
    filtered_data() %>%
      group_by(migration_year, migration_month) %>%
      summarise(total_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(paste(migration_year, migration_month, "01", sep = "-")))
  })
  
  # Plot
  output$migrationPlot <- renderPlotly({
    data <- plot_data()
    
    if(nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(plotly_empty())
    }
    
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = total_migrants)) +
      geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Migration from", input$fromInput, "to", input$toInput),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Number of Migrants"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)
    
    ggplotly(p) %>%
      layout(hovermode = "x unified")
  })
  
  # Data table
  output$results <- renderDT({
    filtered_data() %>%
      select(migration_year, migration_month, num_migrants, 
             country_from_name, country_to_name, 
             region_from, region_to) %>%
      arrange(migration_year, migration_month)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
